mapper.select: SELECT GROUP_ID, GROUP_NAME, GROUP_DESC, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME FROM TBL_RISK_GROUP GROUP_NAME LIKE '%' || #{groupName} || '%' ORDER BY UPDATE_TIME DESC, GROUP_ID DESC
SELECT GROUP_ID, GROUP_NAME, GROUP_DESC, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME FROM TBL_RISK_GROUP ORDER BY GROUP_NAME
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_RISK_GROUP (GROUP_NAME, GROUP_DESC, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME) VALUES (#{groupName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{groupDesc,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_RISK_GROUP SET GROUP_NAME = #{groupName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, GROUP_DESC = #{groupDesc,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}
